_comment: Copy to mcp_servers.json (gitignored) and edit. Each entry is a local MCP
server started over stdio. Restart the backend, or hit Reload on the MCP card
in the admin panel, to pick up changes.
Fields: name (unique, used in the tool names as mcp__<name>__<tool>),
command, args, optional env / cwd / enabled (default true), and an optional
'tools' allow-list to expose only some of the server's tools. Each server may
contribute at most 24 tools (MAX_TOOLS_PER_SERVER in backend/mcp_client.py).
On Windows, 'npx' works — the MCP SDK resolves it to npx.cmd.
